_about: Who publishes each source the code reads that no reader names itself, and what Civitas takes from it, in the words /about/data shows (app/source_names.py). A naming fact per host, written once: the publisher's own name for itself and a plain line of what is read there. Hosts a reader already names are not here: the news feeds (fetch/news_feeds.py's outlet names) and the state election sources (each state registry's source_name, or the republishing office's name), except where that name doesn't read as a publisher (a vendor's or a page's name), which an entry here replaces. tests/test_source_health.py fails while a host the code reads has no name from either, so a new source is named when it is added. Sentence case, no em dashes, no year or Congress number.
